listing.name: Pepsiman — PepsiMan (Cybertwip)
listing.summary: Experimental project. LLE BIOS/CD validation/main handoff only; overlays/progression pending; early native runtime not playable claim. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Japan SLPS-01762 Pepsiman own disc plus SCPH1000 BIOS. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Build bios/game tools, regenerate own BIOS/game, CMake PepsiManRecomp. These are manual setup instructions. Portcove does not manage this download or confirm setup or gameplay.
